prompts.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single wide banner background for a Chinese-language 19th-century grand strategy game's politics panel. Original restrained editorial oil illustration, not a screenshot, no UI and absolutely no text. Subject: a quiet Qing imperial council room circa 1836, three small robed officials around a low wooden table with a few neatly rolled documents, red columns framing distant roof silhouettes. Composition: panoramic 3:1, simple strong silhouette grouping occupying middle-right, subdued empty shadow at left suitable for overlay title. Muted deep teal charcoal, antique gold and dusty red palette, broad painterly shapes, soft daylight, minimal clutter. Clear at small interface size. No ornate busy patterns, no flags, no logos, no modern objects. 1536x512 landscape.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single wide banner background for a Chinese-language 19th-century grand strategy game's population panel. Original restrained painterly illustration, no interface, no writing, no text. Subject: simple 1836 Chinese canal town street with small groups of ordinary residents, a farmer carrying a basket, a cloth merchant at a stall, a worker and a parent walking with a child; tiled roofs and a short stone bridge in the background. Panoramic 3:1 composition, people have clear separated silhouettes, middle-right scene, dark quiet left side for title overlay. Muted charcoal teal, warm parchment, subdued ochre, gentle morning light. Broad clear painted masses rather than detailed faces. Minimal visual clutter; no logos, no banners with writing, no modern objects. 1536x512 landscape.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single panoramic banner background for a Chinese-language 19th-century grand strategy diplomacy panel. Original restrained painterly illustration, no interface, absolutely no text. Subject: a Qing diplomat in dark robe and a European envoy in early 19th-century formal coat seated across a polished table, folded treaty document and wax seal between them, a small antique terrestrial globe at right, tall curtained window and vague harbor sailing ships beyond. Calm formal negotiation, respectful neutral expressions. 3:1 panoramic composition, two distinctive silhouettes centered-right, shadowed uncluttered left side for UI title. Muted charcoal teal, antique brass, warm parchment and burgundy, soft side light. Simple recognizable forms, minimal props, no flags, no logos, no modern objects. 1536x512 landscape.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE sprite atlas texture for a historical strategy game, 2048x1536, exactly TWO equal columns and FOUR equal rows, eight rectangular scene tiles; each cell 1024 wide x384 tall, all boundaries precisely aligned, zero gutters, zero frames, no labels, no text anywhere. Each tile is an original minimal painted building scene, strong easily identifiable building silhouette centered, understated background, no characters necessary, restrained oil illustration with muted charcoal teal, golden ochre and parchment colors. TOP ROW left: Chinese rice farm with low farmhouse and paddy rows, right: timber logging camp with stacked logs and sawmill beside pines. SECOND ROW left: coal mine tunnel in dark rock with black coal wagon, right: red iron ore quarry with timber mine frame and red ore carts. THIRD ROW left: 19th century tool foundry, brick forge glowing orange and clear anvil, right: Chinese textile workshop with visible wooden loom and orderly rolls of cloth. BOTTOM ROW left: building construction site with bamboo scaffolding, hoist and stacked bricks, right: early black steam locomotive and modest railway station with rails. Each tile is a complete separate wide scene, keep key subject near center and ensure different subjects immediately distinguishable. Same visual style and lighting across tiles. Avoid complicated ornaments, crowded streets, modern vehicles, logos, writing, border decorations or uneven grid. Not a user interface screenshot; a clean production sprite atlas.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE uniform painted portrait sprite atlas for a historical game's social class cards. Image 2048x1024, exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, eight 512x512 square cells, no gutters no borders no text no lettering no numbers. Each cell has a single distinct half-body Chinese adult circa1836 with simple occupational attribute, centered face and torso, dark muted teal background, restrained oil brushwork, strong recognizable silhouettes rather than ornate detail. TOP ROW left to right: farmer wearing straw hat holding rice stalks; laborer in indigo work clothes carrying a sack over shoulder; skilled machinist with leather apron and a small hand tool; shopkeeper with round cloth cap and abacus. BOTTOM ROW left to right: wealthy merchant in neat silk robe holding ledger; elderly gentry aristocrat wearing formal dark Qing hat and reserved robe; unemployed laborer in patched muted brown jacket and lowered empty hands, dignified not caricatured; scholar clerk in plain robe with writing brush. Cohesive subdued amber, parchment and charcoal palette. Natural varied adult faces, readable small thumbnail composition, no historical famous likenesses, no ornate frames, no flags, no modern machinery or Western modern suits. Maintain exactly eight cells with aligned grid.

Create an ORIGINAL sprite sheet for a restrained Chinese-language 19th-century grand strategy game UI. 4 columns by 2 rows, EXACTLY EIGHT equally sized square icon cells, no gutters, no borders, no words or letters, no numbers, no logo. Overall 2:1 landscape. Every cell has the same plain dark petrol blue background #20292d. Each cell has ONLY one small arrangement of 2 historical objects at the center, a simple broad readable silhouette, restrained realistic hand-painted oil illustration, muted antique brass, ivory, faded red. Lots of empty margin within every cell so works as 64px UI icon, no fussy scenes, no people. Strict row-major order: top left LANDOWNERS = rolled parchment deed and a large red carved seal; top second INDUSTRIALISTS = miniature brick factory with two chimneys; top third RURAL FOLK = bundle of golden rice and wooden hoe; top fourth INTELLIGENTSIA = open book and Chinese writing brush. Bottom left DEVOUT = bronze temple incense burner with three incense sticks (no text); bottom second ARMED FORCES = crossed Qing saber and plain military banner; bottom third PETITE BOURGEOISIE = wooden abacus with a little folded cloth; bottom fourth TRADE UNIONS = crossed worker hammers and one simple iron cog. Crisp clearly distinguished silhouettes at small size. Do not copy existing game assets. No decorative frame. Avoid gradients, glow, modern symbols, clutter.
